resources.string: Off by default. When RamSaver is active, keeps a resource event panel visible at the upper left: blue for creation, orange for destruction. New events replace old rows; drag, use the mouse wheel or scrollbar to browse the last 512 events, and tap Latest to return. Deep performance diagnostics + Performance overlay adds the same creation/destruction colors above the frame chart; green/yellow/red timing bars remain unchanged. Does not enable verbose logs. Restart the game after changing. Diagnostic rendering adds overhead; use briefly.
